slices.focus: Initial onboarding and personal profile collection for Park Jae-hyun.
slices.summary: Jae-hyun introduces himself fully: a 33-year-old ISTJ dispatch manager in Busan working at Daejin Coastal Logistics, newly married to dental hygienist Choi Min-seo, with family obligations to his mother's seafood stall and younger sister's exam prep, chronic health strain from shift work, and a core goal of stabilizing port dispatch reliability.
open_loops: Verbal handoff conflict with Captain Lee Sang-ho

slices.focus: Seafood handoff failure prompts formal incident log against verbal culture.
slices.summary: A costly missed seafood-client transfer window caused by an unlogged freezer-truck delay during shift change. Jae-hyun documents evidence (radio times, whiteboard photos, captain call records) and gets operations chief approval to trial a single incident log for handoff failures, with a required consequence field.
open_loops: Captain Lee Sang-ho's cooperation with written reporting
Kim Dong-wook's staffing support for the trial
decisions: After a costly missed seafood-client handoff, Jae-hyun is still dispatch manager but has informally taken on documenting
